restrictions: Use only 55-byte messages, the standard fixed IV, indices 0 through 30 on the single padded block, full feed-forward, and the full 256-bit digest.
Draw two fresh independent uniform 256-bit RAM words per message; keep all bits of the first and the high 184 bits of the second. Generate exactly 2^128 messages with replacement.
Use two stable 128-bit counting-sort passes over three-word records, with all 2^128 counters cleared on each pass. Charge both record arrays and the counter array.
Require distinct messages and verify a returned pair by complete re-hashing. No restarts or sampling-dependent resource discounts are used.
Preprocessing is included in total time. nonuniform_advice_log2_bytes=0 bounds one byte; actual nonuniform advice is zero.
This is a distribution-free analytic construction, not a computed collision, empirical attack, claimed improvement over the nominal reference, or claim to beat pending practical-attack submissions.
